places.name: New River Gorge: Bridge Buttress
places.access: Pull-offs on one-way Fayette Station Rd (no vehicles over 12 ft); park only where marked.

places.name: New River Gorge: Endless Wall
places.access: NPS, no fee. The small Fern Creek lot fills, and cars on Lansing-Edmond Rd may be towed (use the Nuttall lot); no overnight parking.

places.name: New River Gorge: Kaymoor
places.access: Park at the Kaymoor Top lot (the Arrowhead lot as overflow); no overnight parking.
